resources.string: The system file picker is unavailable. Check that a document provider is installed.
Search names, descriptions, tags or catalog IDs
Adjust the keywords, domain or stage. The complete catalog comes from the bundled experiment assets.
Guests can run local experiments offline. Archives stay on this device. After signing in, explicitly choose which to copy; nothing is assigned automatically.
Local experiments and downloaded archives work offline. Saves go to this device first; cloud confirmation, retries and conflicts are shown separately.
Opening an experiment creates recovery checkpoints. You can also import a JSON archive. Cloud archives not yet downloaded cannot be restored offline.
No matching guest archives are on this device. Guest data is never uploaded or merged into this account automatically.
Full checkpoint: playback, editing and undo/redo history
Legacy scene or not yet downloaded: complete history is unconfirmed
The cloud scene was deleted. The local recovery point is retained. To sync further changes, save a new copy.
Copies only into the local partition of this account. The guest original is retained; sync is requested only after you select Save.
Copy into this account and open
The local scene, checkpoint and manually saved version of “%1$s” will be deleted. This cannot be undone and does not request cloud deletion.
This scene still has a cloud version or unresolved sync operations. Resolve synchronization before removing its local recovery point.
Saved to the local guest partition. Nothing was uploaded.
Saved on this device. Check the sync status for cloud confirmation.
No observations have been recorded. Record conditions in the Data panel before exporting the comparison table. No empty success file was generated.
Unable to open system sharing. The export was not sent; please retry.

The experiment canvas retains play, pause, reset, step and timeline controls. Open Parameters, Apparatus, Data, Guide and Report panels. Construction, dragging, zooming, wiring, undo and redo stay in the local experiment module. Readings, curves and validation results are available in Data. Native Save requests a complete checkpoint. Backgrounding pauses the module and attempts a checkpoint; returning does not simulate elapsed wall-clock time.
Guest archives stay on this device. To sync across devices, sign in and explicitly copy from Guest archives.
This archive contains only a legacy scene. Original editing history and playback progress cannot be recovered. Future checkpoints will preserve the new complete state.
A local recovery checkpoint exists; this is not cloud confirmation

Neither version will be overwritten automatically. Save the current local state as a new scene and sync it, leaving the original conflict intact; or back up the local state before downloading and using the full cloud version. A failed download does not discard the original sync operation.
Save local state as a new scene
Back up local and use cloud
Latest checkpoint could not be saved
The last successfully written checkpoint remains on this device, but recent changes may be lost. Retry or stay here. Leaving will not be reported as a successful save.
No checkpoint has been successfully written. Leaving now may lose all changes from this session. Please retry first.
Version conflict; choose how to proceed
New save awaiting the previous operation receipt
The account instance changed. This renderer has stopped and will not save previous-account data into the new account. Go back and reopen.
The network is unavailable. Local archives still work; cloud operations have not been marked successful.
Sign in again from Account. Local versions and queued operations are retained.
The complete bundled catalog could not be read. Retry or check the experiment asset build; a demo catalog is not a replacement.
No local checkpoint is available for this scene, or it was explicitly removed.
Local storage failed. Check free space and retry. Saving has not been confirmed.
The renderer did not provide a current complete checkpoint. Wait for loading or restore the renderer, then retry.
The complete data exceeds the allowed size. Content and editing history have not been truncated.
The archive is not supported declarative JSON, or its full checkpoint failed validation. No embedded code was executed.
The system browser is unavailable. External pages never open in the local renderer with a native bridge.
The operation did not complete. Please retry. An existing local checkpoint is not treated as cloud success.
A secure system WebView is required
This WebView does not support the restricted message bridge. Update Android System WebView or the system browser, then retry. No unsafe fallback will be used.
Check the local experiment assets and retry. Error code: %1$s
The renderer was released under memory pressure. Recovery uses the latest received checkpoint; changes not successfully saved may be lost.
Recreate the local renderer from the latest received content or checkpoint. Changes not successfully saved may be lost.
